title: Z-Image took the default slot
summary:
The year turned over with a new default image model, more reliable Pollen accounting, and fixes that make API responses behave the way their parameters suggest.

Z-Image replaced flux as the default image model, and requests naming `flux` now resolve to Z-Image too. It also gained SPAN 2× upscaling for requests above its native pixel budget, with aspect ratios preserved within output limits.

Balance tracking now separates daily tier grants from purchased packs, spends tier Pollen first, and gives the dashboard a breakdown of both balances. Follow-up changes keep tier grants in sync after subscription changes and refresh a stored zero balance when a higher balance is available. The FAQ also draws generation estimates from model pricing data rather than fixed examples.

Streaming text can arrive in SSE chunks instead of waiting behind deduplication. `seed=-1` now produces fresh text and images, while explicit image seeds retain their intended behavior. Chat completions accept three more reasoning-effort values; Gemini 3 Flash fast mode sends a zero-token thinking budget; and an endpoint change addressed response blocks for `openai-large` GPT-5.2.

Play gained a Watch Feed for completed community images, and Model Monitor gained a 60-minute view alongside its 5-minute view. Mobile table fixes make model health, API keys, and pricing easier to inspect on narrow screens. Browser-based Usage CSV downloads received a header fix.
